Privacy Policy

Draft. This page is a placeholder, not a final policy. The final privacy policy will be published after legal review, and this text may change.

Moss Garden is made by Davy Kim (ipe Studio). The game has not been released yet, and this site collects no personal information — there is no input form and no analytics.

When the game ships, personal information will be handled as follows.

What, and how

  • Accounts — only what is needed for a game account.
  • Advertising — ad-supported versions follow the ad provider's own policy.
  • Contact — a message you send us is used to reply to you, nothing else.

Contact

For privacy requests, write to ipe.haven@gmail.com and put "privacy" in the subject line.

This page will be updated when the final policy is set.
